jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-17m.note: Measured 2026-10-17 on the gate's own metric: budgeted patching, 512-byte axis, patch budget 128, 6000 Stage 1 steps on three Project Gutenberg books. Observed cos_emb_c 0.841, sim_corr 0.717, boundary_acc 0.944, trie coverage 1.00. Floors sit below those so a modestly worse rerun still ships, and far above a randomly initialised byte interface's cos -0.005 / sim_corr 0.241 / boundary 0.228 -- which exports cleanly and passes every check except this one. No other source model has published floors: the other five verified models are alignment-verified (see README, Reusability) but have never been gated, and fidelity numbers do not transfer between architectures, so they are refused rather than guessed.
